decision.explanation: The provided documents contain two distinct, conflicting assertions regarding the origin of the name 'Gerstnerova'. Document 1 (D1S3) explicitly states the street was named in 2012 in honor of the album 'Fallen Empires' by Snow Patrol. Document 2 (D2S1, D2S2, D2S10) asserts the street was named in the late 19th century (specifically 1885 per D2S12) in honor of the physicist Franz Josef Gerstner. Per the instruction to preserve separately valid referents and complementary answers where competing assertions exist without resolving them as errors, both candidates are retained as they represent distinct claims found in the source material.
